implemented.sourceAndControls: After original clip and cached-color invalidation, reserve 4096 + 12*input body length before original replaceAll/replace/body/vertex/header-fragment factories and original compiler closure/native shaders/program/record/Map. Actual lifetime captures working text and every native handle before subsequent native consumers. Fixed controls/text allowance 4096 plus six input-length UTF16 capacities covers the original generated intermediates. Successful native compile/link/shader-delete order and exact original text remain.
implemented.uniformsAndCache: Before each original getActiveUniform/getUniformLocation/Map producer, admit 1024 for actual active-info, renderer-produced flat name under 256 UTF16 units, location and Map entry. Retain 192 + 2*actual name length per entry, dropping active-info after original lookup. At original cache insertion, keep actual canonical body, Program record/native handle/Map and entries at 768 + 2*body length + entries. Working text clears. Existing 64-program eviction order and cached hits stay; canonical owner persists through scratch until original eviction/disposal.
implemented.nativeDiagnostics: WebGL removes info-log length queries, so the pinned 64-bit V8 maximum (<2^29 UTF16 units) supplies a conservative pre-query bound. Admit 4*2^29 + 1024 logical metadata for both original native log and Error.message before getShaderInfoLog/getProgramInfoLog. Insufficient quota denies before query and cleans actual native handles. With quota, original diagnostic/deletion/Error text order remains; clear log and shrink to 512 + 2*Error.message length, holding actual propagated Error through allocator cleanup. This reserves logical metadata capacity; it does not allocate a giant log or claim physical RSS measurements.
implemented.cleanup: Actual unfinished shader/program handles clean once, visit all native children despite first failure and preserve original null over secondary cleanup failures. Cached native program/actual uniform Map/key references clear at original eviction/device disposal, scope exit or allocator-first cleanup. Original empty-string attempted Map key also rolls back after injected null post-insertion producer failure; existing cached owners survive new failures.
implemented.pixelFixtureAllowance: Native depth/PNG storage fixtures had legacy metadata=8192 while checking pixel/native storage. Added shader lifetimes exceed it (accepted peaks 13822/21416), so their metadata allowance is 128KiB. Original 16MiB/8MiB pixel quotas, native buffer/MSAA byte assertions, counts/exact pixels and all explicit source 8KiB or producer one-byte metadata-denial checks remain. Existing pass-container denial adds the actual live 4096+12*body length before the same original Set producer. This is not global aggregate proof.
implemented.scope: Selected WebglDevice transformations/header concatenation, original compile/native controls, renderer-produced flat uniform metadata, cache keys/entries and diagnostic Error lifetime. Caller-generated paint/effect source, dedicated depth/other shader controllers, primary pixel-view/common allocation/helper/ledger/provider/graph/font/Node and actual production/aggregate admission remain pending. Native VM/GL driver/codec private storage and RSS remain separate.
